name: UserTesting
description_en:
UserTesting is an enterprise research platform for collecting human feedback on concepts, prototypes and digital experiences. Its participant network, test builder, moderated conversations and analysis tools support different stages of a research program.

Choosing an edition is only half the purchase decision: current plans also distinguish test-based consumption from team-based unlimited usage. Neither label means every capability or audience is unlimited.
description_zh:
UserTesting 是企业研究平台，可收集对概念、原型和数字体验的人类反馈。参与者网络、测试构建器、主持访谈和分析工具支持研究的不同阶段。

采购时除了选择版本，还需区分按测试消耗与团队范围内不限测试的方案。任何一种名称都不意味着全部功能或人群无限使用。

sections.title_en: Human feedback across the product lifecycle
sections.title_zh: 贯穿产品周期的人类反馈
sections.en: The official plans page lists unmoderated think-aloud tests, surveys, interaction tests and moderated Live Conversations. Advanced includes these core methods, while Ultimate adds capabilities such as card sorting, tree testing, custom audiences and approval flow. AI summaries, AI test creation and AI analysis are separate entitlements; do not infer that the same AI tools are included in all editions.
sections.zh: 官方套餐页列出无主持人口述测试、问卷、交互测试和人工主持 Live Conversation。Advanced 包含这些核心方法，Ultimate 另含卡片分类、树测试、自定义人群和审批流程等能力。AI 摘要、AI 测试创建和 AI 分析是不同权益，不能假定所有版本包含相同 AI 工具。

sections.title_en: Example: test an application form before launch
sections.title_zh: 示例：上线前测试申请表
sections.en: Provide a prototype or working form, define a realistic application task and screen for people who fit the intended audience. Compare the recording and transcript with the observed completion path, then share a short clip showing the obstacle. A live conversation is appropriate when you need to probe an unexpected answer; an unmoderated script must anticipate more of the flow. These are study-design suggestions, not an executed comparison.
sections.zh: 提供原型或可用表单，定义真实感的申请任务，筛选符合目标的人。把录屏和转录与实际完成路径对照，再分享显示障碍的短片。需要追问意外答案时，可以采用实时访谈；无主持人脚本则需要提前考虑更多流程。这是研究设计建议，本文未实际对比。

sections.title_en: Edition and usage model both affect the quote
sections.title_zh: 版本与用量模式共同影响报价
sections.en: All three advertised editions request pricing. Test-based Consumption pays according to test usage and advertises unlimited users rather than seat charges. Team-based Unlimited describes unlimited tests within a defined enterprise scope. Ultimate+ includes that team-based plan and scoped services. The Figma plugin is included with Team-based Unlimited but can be an add-on under other plans; flexible roles also have plan-specific availability. Ask for the exact scope, audience costs and add-ons in writing. No normalized amount is available.
sections.zh: 三个公开版本均需询价。Test-based Consumption 按测试使用付费，宣传不限用户而非按席位收费；Team-based Unlimited 则在明确的企业范围内不限测试。Ultimate+ 包含该团队方案及按范围约定的服务。Figma 插件在团队不限测试方案中包含，在其他方案可能需加购；灵活角色也有方案差异。应书面确认具体范围、人群费用及附加项，本文没有可标准化金额。

sections.title_en: Pilot access, recruitment and evidence quality
sections.title_zh: 试点检查访问、招募和证据质量
sections.en: Start with one research objective, a reachable asset and a short pilot. Confirm participant access, recording quality and whether screeners exclude the wrong people before distributing the study. The pricing FAQ offers a trial request and a free test, which should not be treated as an ongoing free enterprise plan. The service fits repeated research with shared evidence; it does not make a small or biased sample representative. Self-hosting, contractual retention and source-code licensing were not verified.
sections.zh: 先确定一个研究目标，准备可访问材料并做短试点。分发研究前检查参与者访问、录制质量，以及筛选题能否排除不合适人群。套餐 FAQ 提供试用申请和一次免费测试，不能当作持续免费的企业套餐。它适合持续研究与证据共享，但不会使小样本或有偏样本自动具有代表性。自托管、合同保留期限和源码许可仍未核实。

content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Confirm the contractual enterprise scope, recruitment charges, renewal, retention and export rights.
